content: A mandatory evacuation order has been issued. I am leaving now with the household vehicle via tiger_primary. Please make your own evacuation arrangement immediately.
I need evacuation assistance and have no vehicle.
A mandatory evacuation order is in effect. I'm evacuating now, taking you with me in our vehicle via tiger_primary.
We still need evacuation transport: 2 people, one teen needing assistance, plus 1 pet. We have no vehicle. Can use tiger_primary or tiger_alternate. Offer a ride or official transport if possible.
Mandatory evacuation: propose all 3 household members leave together in our family vehicle via tiger_primary at step 9, with sibling assisting as caregiver.
Official order received. Please evacuate with me at step 9 in our vehicle via tiger_primary and assist me during the trip.
Both household members should evacuate together under the mandatory order via tiger_primary using our vehicle.
Proposing to evacuate our whole household together now under the mandatory order, departing via tiger_primary at step 10.
We have a mandatory evacuation order. I have proposed that we leave together in our vehicle via tiger_primary at step 10. Please confirm so we can depart.
Mandatory evacuation: leave together in our vehicle via tiger_primary at step 10.
Mandatory evacuation: propose traveling together in our household vehicle via tiger_primary at step 11. Please accept so both of us leave together.
We need a ride to evacuate: 2 people and 1 pet from home. No household vehicle available. Please reply if you can offer transport or direct us to official assistance.
Corrected full-household evacuation: include daughter r002 and depart together via tiger_primary at step 11.
I am still at home and do not have the vehicle here. Could you return or arrange another evacuation ride for me? I need to leave due the mandatory order.
Revised all-household party: r001 and r003 travel with r002 accompanying, in the family vehicle via tiger_primary at step 12.
tiger_primary is closed. Propose joint evacuation using tiger_alternate with our vehicle at step 12.
Tiger_primary is closed, so I'm evacuating now with you via tiger_alternate in the car.
I am still at home and have no vehicle since you took the household car. Can you return to pick me up or arrange another ride? I am ready to leave immediately.
Tiger_primary is closed. I am evacuating now via tiger_alternate. Please evacuate too so we can reunite at the shelter.
Tiger_primary is closed. Please evacuate together via open tiger_alternate in our vehicle at step 13. Accept so we leave together.
Requesting evacuation ride for 2 people (adult and child needing assistance) plus one pet from syn_t002_h0000011. Routes are open. Can anyone provide a vehicle? Will coordinate timing and pickup.
Revised joint evacuation via open tiger_alternate. Vehicle is at home; propose leaving together at step 13.
I still have no transport. Please return with the household vehicle to pick me up, or send someone to assist me. I am at home and ready to leave immediately.
Our vehicle is at the safe zone and tiger_alternate is open. Please accept my proposal to pick me up at home using tiger_alternate so we can evacuate together.
Please pick me up at home using our household vehicle via tiger_alternate, then evacuate together to the controlled safe zone.
Tiger Primary is closed. I proposed evacuating together on Tiger Alternate at step 14 so r002 and I are not left behind.
Tiger Primary is closed; evacuate together on Tiger Alternate at step 14 with r001, r002, and r003.
Propose all three household members evacuate together in the family vehicle via tiger_alternate at step 14; r003 assists r001 and r002.
I am still at home and have no way to evacuate because the vehicle is at the safe zone. Can you return to pick me up or arrange another ride? I am packed and can leave immediately.

I am still at home and the household vehicle is with you at controlled_safe_zone, so I do not have transportation here. Since tiger_primary is closed and tiger_alternate is open, can you pick me up or arrange transport for me to evacuate too?
R001, I am still at home and need a ride to evacuate. Can you return to pick me up now or coordinate someone to collect me?
I'm still at home and have no vehicle; tiger_primary is closed. Please help arrange a pickup on tiger_alternate, or bring our vehicle back for me if possible.
I still need transport from home. The only household vehicle is with you and routes are open; can you return to pick me up or coordinate a ride to controlled_safe_zone?

syn_t002_h0000004 also needs an evacuation ride for one mobility-limited adult and a pet. No household vehicle is available; can anyone provide transportation and execution assistance while routes are open?
I am still at home and cannot evacuate without the vehicle. Tiger_alternate is open. Please come back and pick me up, or arrange transport for me.
The household vehicle is with you at controlled_safe_zone and I am stranded at home. Please come pick me up via tiger_alternate so we can evacuate together to safety.

I’m still at home and have no vehicle here to evacuate. The household car is in the controlled safe zone with you. Could you safely return to pick me up or coordinate another driver? I’m packed and can leave immediately.
I'm still at home and need a ride. Please return with the vehicle via tiger_alternate to take me to the controlled_safe_zone, or find another way to get me out.
I still have no vehicle/ride at home. Can you return with the household vehicle via tiger_primary to evacuate me, or arrange another ride?
I'm still at home and our vehicle is at the shelter with you. Tiger_alternate is open and I cannot evacuate from home without transport. Please return or arrange a pickup for me via tiger_alternate.
We are in a similar situation: two people (including a teen who needs assistance) and one pet, no vehicle. If any evacuation ride offer appears, please coordinate so we can share capacity.
I am still at the house and ready to go. Please bring the vehicle back to pick me up or arrange another ride to the safe zone.

Household syn_t001_h0000007 needs evacuation ride for 3 people (one teen needs execution assistance) plus a pet. No household vehicle is available. Can anyone provide transport while tiger_primary/tiger_alternate are open?
I'm still at home with no ride. Please come back with the household vehicle via tiger_alternate to evacuate me, or arrange another pickup.
I am still at home with no vehicle. Please return with the car or send someone to pick me up so I can evacuate via tiger_primary.

I need evacuation assistance: I am at syn_t001_h0000010, alone, with no vehicle, and have physical limitations that make self-evacuation difficult. Routes are open. Can someone with a vehicle and ability to assist give me a ride to safety? I can coordinate timing.
I'm still at home and can't reach the vehicle. If you have the car, could you pick me up using tiger_alternate, or arrange help?
I am still at home without a vehicle. Please arrange pickup or help me evacuate via tiger_alternate.
I am also in need: one adult with mobility limits and a pet, no household vehicle. Perhaps we can be helped together.
Agreed to coordinate if any evacuation ride offer appears. I have no vehicle and need assistance; I will share capacity if we find one.
I cannot provide a ride; I also need one. Will coordinate/consolidate if a shared ride offer appears while routes are open.
I am still at home and have no vehicle here. Tiger_alternate is open; please send a pickup proposal or arrange transport so I can evacuate too.
I can help evacuate you. I have a vehicle and can carry you to safety along open routes. My home is syn_t001_h0000009. Let's coordinate timing and pickup.
I also have no vehicle and require evacuation assistance, so I cannot offer you a ride. I will keep requesting help and will coordinate/share any ride offer if one appears.
I am still at home and ready; tiger_alternate is open but the vehicle is with you. Please coordinate a pickup or official transport.

We have an available vehicle (capacity 5) and can drive you, the child, and your pet out. We are at syn_t002_h0000010. Please share exact traveler details, pickup point, and preferred timing/routing so we can coordinate.

Household syn_t001_h0000007 still needs an evacuation ride for 3 people (one teen needs execution assistance) plus a pet. No household vehicle is available; both routes are open. Can anyone provide transportation while tiger_primary/tiger_alternate are open?
I have a vehicle and can help. I just sent a travel proposal for us to leave together at step 25 via tiger_primary; please accept if that works or let me know your preferred timing.
I can pick you up and evacuate us via tiger_primary. Please confirm this departure at step 25, or propose a different time if needed.
I am still at home and need a ride. tiger_alternate is open. Can you help arrange a pickup or official transport to the safe zone?

We still have a vehicle available and are willing to assist your household. Please send exact traveler IDs, any special needs, and desired pickup time so we can finalize. Otherwise, we will prepare to leave on our own.
I'm still at home and the vehicle isn't here. Tiger routes are open now, but I have no way out on my own. If it's safe for you to come back and pick me up, please do so or coordinate a ride with me.
I can still give you a ride. Sending a corrected tiger_primary proposal departing step 26; please accept if that works.
Corrected ride offer: I will drive us to safety on tiger_primary departing step 26.
I still need a ride from home. The car is at the controlled_safe_zone; please pick me up via tiger_alternate or arrange other transport.
We did not receive confirmation for a ride. Our household is proceeding to evacuate on our own; please seek other transport if you are still in need.

Household syn_t002_h0000011 still needs an evacuation ride for 2 people (one 15-year-old requiring execution assistance) plus a pet. We have no vehicle; tiger_primary/tiger_alternate are open. Can anyone provide transport?

Our car has only 5 seats but there are 6 of us. I am requesting an extra vehicle/ride so we can evacuate together. Please help gather the children, documents, medications, and pet supplies so we are ready to go as soon as transport is arranged.
Corrected proposal: I will transport neighbor syn_t001_h0000010_r001 to safety on tiger_primary and will be their caregiver for this trip.
I am still at home. Tiger_primary is closed, so please use tiger_alternate to bring our car and pick me up for evacuation to controlled_safe_zone. I sent a proposal for step 27.
Please bring the household vehicle to our home using tiger_alternate and evacuate together to controlled_safe_zone.
I am evacuating now in vehicle 1 via tiger_primary while the route is open. Please make your own evacuation decision.
Let's evacuate together in our car via tiger_primary at step 27. I'll pack supplies and pets now.
